title: Yeh Rishta Kya Kehlata Hai: Abhir’s jealousy peaks as he leaves the sofa to share bed with Kiara
summary: Star Plus serial Yeh Rishta Kya Kehlata Hai advances multiple emotional storylines. Ruhi struggles with resurfacing feelings for Armaan while serving as the couple's surrogate. Meanwhile Kiara tries to make Abhir jealous by imitating his habits, prompting Abhir to move from the sofa to the bed to catch her. The episode raises questions about loyalties, surrogacy and emotional consequences.
content:
Star Plus' iconic show Yeh Rishta Kya Kehlata Hai is once again steering toward an emotional love triangle. Following Rohit's tragic death, Ruhi finds herself gradually drawn back to Armaan. Although she is trying to suppress these feelings and avoid thinking about him, her subconscious betrays her — Ruhi begins dreaming of Armaan kissing her forehead, Abhir walking away from him, and a possible future together.

Once portrayed with grey shades, Ruhi is now making a conscious effort to distance herself from Armaan emotionally, scolding herself whenever such thoughts cross her mind. However, her recurring dreams and emotional turmoil are making it difficult to hold back. This shift has left viewers speculating whether Ruhi might once again slip into past negative tendencies and pursue Armaan, putting his marriage with Abhir at risk.

Adding complexity, Ruhi is the surrogate mother for Armaan and Abhir's unborn child. That role raises fresh dilemmas: will she be able to hand the baby over to the couple, or will her emotions complicate the arrangement? The surrogacy angle increases the stakes and has fans debating what choices Ruhi might make under emotional strain.

On the other side of the story, the love triangle involving Kiara is heating up. After discovering Charu and Abhir’s relationship, Kiara has decided to mirror Abhir’s behavior. She is trying to make him jealous by frequently bringing up Samrat, a friend she now spends a lot of time with — someone who brings a smile to her face. She has also started following a similar routine as Abhir, leaving the house early, returning late, avoiding conversations and going straight to bed.

In the upcoming episode of Yeh Rishta Kya Kehlata Hai, late at night Abhir is sleeping on the sofa while Kiara is on the bed, as usual. Suddenly he hears whispers and giggles as Kiara pretends to have a conversation with Samrat. When he questions her, she casually dismisses it and implies that he must be imagining things.

Shortly after, Abhir quietly picks up his blanket and shifts to the bed. This unusual move surprises Kiara and prompts her to ask about the change in his behavior. Abhir responds by saying he will now sleep there just to prove that his ears are not playing tricks on him and then asks her to carry on with her conversation. The small, intimate confrontation underscores growing tensions and the fragile balance in relationships.

The episode underscores recurring themes of jealousy, miscommunication and unresolved feelings. As both triangles and surrogacy-related tensions evolve, viewers are left wondering which attachments will hold and which will fracture. The show continues to generate speculation about character choices and future twists.
